vars.label: Land steeper than 15% (%)
vars.ref: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP), 1/3 arc-second (about 10 m) seamless elevation model, tiles of 2026-07-22; slope of every 10 m cell by Horn's method, counted by barrio; municipios and Puerto Rico pool their barrios
vars.definition: The share of the area's land steeper than 15%. 15% is where building and farming begin to need terraces or special design. Slope is the rise over the run, as a percent: 10% climbs 10 m in 100 m, and 100% is 45 degrees. It is computed for every 10 m cell of the USGS elevation model (bare ground, not buildings or trees) from its eight neighbors (Horn's method). A cell counts in the barrio that holds the center of its 60 m block; municipios and Puerto Rico pool their barrios. Coastal cells next to the sea have no slope.
